data.gender_notes: Leeniyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'lain', meaning 'gentleness'. In Islamic tradition, this name represents the soft and soothing qualities of a loving mother or a compassionate friend. The name Leeniyyah carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Leeniyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leeniyyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
